messages:
people-ops-bot: Heads-up: Priya's birthday is Thu Jul 22. Quick options poll — react with :one:, :two:, or :three: 1) Office pizza lunch 12:30pm (veg + GF slices), 2) Desk plant + handwritten card shipped to remote folks, 3) 30-min virtual trivia + e-card. Reply with preferences or allergies.
harriet (People Ops): We can combine 1+2 for in-office folks if people want both. Need to know plant allergies (rare) and shipping addresses. Please fill form by Tue noon.
priya: aww thanks!! I'm low-key — plants make me so happy tho. No big cake pls. :seedling: small please.
josh: :one: pizza is my instinct but :two: desk plant is adorable. leaning :two:.
li: :two: + happy to write a silly haiku in the card. GF slices ok.
amir: :three: works for my timezone, but if majority picks in-office I can swing by early.
eliza: :two: plant pls. allergic to lilies FYI.
harriet (People Ops): noted lily allergy. we'll pick low-pollen succulents (safe). Form: https://forms.gle/priya-bday-poll — pick 1/2/3, dietary notes, shipping address if remote. Closing Tue 12:00 PT.
priya: thanks for the plant idea! also, no latex balloons (please).
josh: volunteer to pick up pizza if 1 wins. will avoid cross-contamination with GF box.
li: i'll add my haiku to the card. short and embarrassing guaranteed.
amir: i'll join trivia if it's after 4pm my time.
people-ops-bot: Event placeholder: "Priya birthday Plant or Pizza?" (will finalize after poll). Reminder set for Mon.
harriet (People Ops): small logistics note: office policy says single-use plastic minimized, so if pizza, we'll use compostable plates. if shipping plants, include care note card.
eliza: DM'ing my mailing address.
priya: you all are the sweetest :heart: thank you. tiny plant is perfect.
harriet (People Ops): final reminder  please fill the form by Tue noon so we can order. I'll post results after close and send calendar invite if in-office or trivia wins. Keep replies short to avoid channel spam.
